notes: This focused contract records the terminal-callback boundary for the bounded Unconditional Attribute Ownership Divestiture profile. A queued Request Attribute Ownership Assumption callback is rechecked before FederateAmbassador code: if the candidate has stopped publishing, the callback is suppressed and its outstanding candidate reservation is released. A later publication therefore continues the unowned search and produces one fresh grouped offer while the instance attribute remains unowned, carrying the original divestiture tag. The search reservation is also reset whenever an attribute becomes owned, so a later divestiture starts a fresh ownership-transfer epoch and can offer a previously invited federate again after it republishes. The callback-return continuation regression additionally completes a different candidate's already-queued cancellation confirmation while the first assumption callback is in user code; when the first callback returns without acquisition, the same unowned search advances to that newly eligible candidate exactly once. The behavior is traced to the exported ownership candidates for tag propagation, eligibility, the continuing unowned search, the single-offer callback rule, and the stop-at-ownership boundary; it does not claim complete ownership arbitration, RTI-owned state, every resignation action, negotiated divestiture, save/restore, DDM, timestamped/retraction behavior, remote transport, packaging, JUnit/protected review, or conformance.
